title: The Pagination Bug
description: Transaction pages omit records from bulk imports and return unstable ordering.
objective: Reproduce the reported failures and repair the implementation without changing its public interfaces.
expectedBehavior: Transaction.created_at is UTC microseconds since epoch (normalize timezone offsets before constructing records). Sort timestamp DESC then id DESC; cursor must preserve both keys at full microsecond precision. Limit 1..100; malformed cursors throw. Pages never cross account boundaries.
constraints: Use the C++17 standard library and supplied read-only helpers only.
Do not change read-only files or tests.
